source_name: State Secretary of State business registries (50 states + DC)
organization: Individual state Secretary of State offices
license: varies by state (per-state legal review required)
access: public search free; bulk often paid/authenticated/per-state-agreement
planning_only_reason: Generic source representing 51 separate jurisdictions with NO common schema. No single dataset was downloaded (Colorado is cataloged separately as the open exemplar). Fields below are the common conceptual fields documented in the source inventory; exact names, codes, formats, and availability differ per state and many bulk feeds are paid or require per-state agreements.

fields.meaning: Registered business entity name (field name varies per state).
fields.limitations: Planning-only/generic. Concrete observed values exist only for Colorado (separate catalog).
fields.analysis_notes: Authoritative name source for the mass of US private companies.

fields.meaning: Legal form / entity type (LLC, corporation, LP, etc.); each state uses its own code set.
fields.limitations: Planning-only/generic; code sets differ per state.

fields.meaning: Date of formation/registration in that state.
Standing/status of the entity with the state register.
fields.limitations: Planning-only/generic; status vocabularies differ per state.

fields.meaning: Registered agent for service of process (person or commercial agent).
fields.analysis_notes: Most states publish a registered agent; few publish owners/officers openly.
